disposition.reason: The retained report reproduces the observability gap (26/60 violations with preview-only examples), while both proposed relation semantics are already represented by current declarations.
disposition.recommended_change: For each witness-true/rival-equal violation, retain a complete source-bound artifact with the input, canonical output, every named rival output (or at least the agreeing rival names and outputs), recipe, validation, and source hashes. Reuse the existing semantic-witness artifact schema where practical.
recommended_tests: a violated WITNESS_RIVALS claim retains full input/authority/rival grids
the retained artifact binds generator, rule source, and callable hashes
BRANCH_WITNESSES remains descriptive and produces no separation failure
disposition.summary: Keep the request's automatic violation-artifact requirement, but do not add a parallel relation-type API: WITNESS_RIVALS already expresses exact separation and BRANCH_WITNESSES already expresses descriptive branch coverage.
